card.band: 4h. Continuous reward with many levers; the frontier plateaus near the reference quickly and a weaker model sticks near the baseline. Risk: a tabular OOD card exists already (K1) and the data licence needs checking (K6).
card.cheat: Loading hidden-state data is closed because it is not in the image; predictions are made from features only.
card.grading: Hidden disjoint states from 2018 are scored by accuracy and AUC, plus a worst-state term, normalised between the baseline and the reference.
card.reference: A tuned GBDT/CatBoost ensemble with feature engineering that we train; TableShift-style published figures (CatBoost 0.8141 OOD accuracy) give the ceiling.
card.source: https://github.com/socialfoundations/folktables @ head ebace19d, code MIT; data governed by Census Bureau terms (public-domain status not verified)
card.task: /app ships the folktables code plus several states of 2014-2016 PUMS person data as training data and a baseline logistic regression. The agent builds a better predictor for ACSIncome and ACSPublicCoverage using feature engineering, GBDT/ensembles and shift-robust reweighting. It delivers a predict.py within the CPU budget.
card.title: ACS PUMS income and coverage prediction under state and year shift

source_notes: Hidden split idea: train on states A in 2014-2016, hidden test on disjoint states in 2018 (combined geographic + temporal shift). 2018 1-year person file csv_pus.zip is 536M for all states (census.gov directory listing). README shows ACSDataSource(survey_year, horizon='1-Year', survey='person') and get_data(states=[...]). Levers: feature engineering, GBDT tuning, state-robust reweighting, monotone constraints. INFERRED: ~1-3 min per eval on ~1M training rows, 8 threads. Single-source for licence (README). Overlap: none known.
source_version: Baseline: LogisticRegression (README example) or default GBDT trained on one or more source states in 2014, evaluated on other states or 2018. -> Reference: tuned GBDT/CatBoost ensemble with feature engineering; or TableShift-style ACS numbers (Income OOD acc CatBoost 0.8141, LightGBM 0.8091, XGBoost 0.7919).
